provenance.notes: Manually reconstructed from the inspected original flattened PDF figure. Ordinary labels are live typeable text; panels, graph geometry and arrows are native editable shapes or paths. Source layout and contents retained; font metrics, line widths and decorative effects approximated. Flattened original rebuilt with individual source asset photographs and robot/scene renderings. All captions, task instructions and reward/code labels are live typeable text. Outlined arrows and caption boxes are native; four small model-logo icons retain original pixels.
